patches.decision_note: Android and iOS have different language sets and independently failing localization implementations, so their localization lifecycles must be extracted separately.
Repeated freelancer questions leave material uncertainty about whether an independently selectable in-app language control is required, but no client decision is visible.
The client requires localized social-media links, but the evidence does not resolve whether localization applies to labels, destinations, or regional accounts.
The iPad layout appears independently testable, but the supplied evidence does not safely establish whether the client separately authorized its cleanup.
